secondary_starts: Full available history; legacy cached PE proxy entry for three stocks
rolling_cohorts: Every eligible January from 2000 through 2021, five calendar years, monthly, 5bp; no start-date selection
exposure_control: Constant stock weight set to each potential strategy's measured average daily closing exposure; ex-post risk diagnostic, not a deployable prespecified strategy
execution: Observe first available trading-day adjusted opening quote each month, recompute and trade at that quote. Daily variant trades each opening quote. No intrabar or threshold-price fills. Zero observation/execution latency assumed; 20bp stress includes larger aggregate costs but does not reproduce latency.
accounting: Fractional units in adjusted total-return price indices; adjusted open = raw open * adjusted close / raw close. Cash yield zero, no borrowing, no shorts, taxes zero. Fees charged on each subaccount's gross trades. Terminal mark-to-market, no forced liquidation.
drawdown: Daily adjusted close marked equity including initial capital as first peak; intraday drawdown not measured
fundamentals: Cached PE series are not accepted as clean TTM: missing quarters in prior EPS extraction. Entry dates are legacy-proxy sensitivity only; no S_Tech or production algorithm performance claims.
scope: Retrospective exploratory replay of previously examined, survivor-biased technology assets. Not an untouched out-of-sample test. No parameter fitting. Cached data only; sources remain unchanged.
